blockingIssues.problem: The idea asserts that numbered lockers caused the reduction in lost-item reports, but the source explicitly says the note does not isolate a cause and other changes (staffing and opening hours) also occurred.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source: 'Six stations tried numbered lockers in July; lost-item reports fell from 18 to 11. Staffing and opening hours also changed. The note does not isolate a cause.'
blockingIssues.constraint: Do not present numbered lockers as the proven cause of the reduction in lost-item reports because the source only reports a concurrent decrease and explicitly states it does not isolate a cause.
